dialect.detail: Likely compiled with GnuCOBOL (OpenCOBOL); uses LINE SEQUENTIAL, SET with inline *> comments, COMP with LOW-VALUES, and STOP literal — consistent with GnuCOBOL on Windows. INSTALLATION shows CITI but file paths are Windows local drives.

purpose.domain_detail: MRP (Material Requirements Planning) inventory pegging — reads an Item Master file and a Bill of Materials file, displays item and BOM records
purpose.summary: This program reads an Item Master flat file and a Bill of Materials flat file, then displays each record's fields to the console while counting rows. It is part of an MRP/inventory pegging exercise, likely for a shampoo manufacturing scenario. The BOM reader section is commented out, suggesting work in progress.

notable_features: SET statement used for EOF flag
COMP group item initialized with LOW-VALUES
Windows absolute file paths in SELECT clauses
Continuation line with leading hyphen in PROCEDURE DIVISION display
BOM processing section commented out — incomplete
verdict.notes: The program has a continuation line syntax anomaly (hyphen in column 7 after DISPLAY TEXT-OUT) that may cause a compile warning. The BOM reader-writer perform is commented out. INSTALLATION shows CITI (Citibank?) but the overall style and Windows paths suggest a personal/educational exercise rather than production mainframe code. No EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS, no COPY statements.
